examples.text_en: His obstinacy made the talks long and hard.
examples.text_zh: 他的顽固让谈判又长又难。

examples.text_en: She was known for her obstinacy at work.
examples.text_zh: 她因工作中的固执而出名。

examples.text_en: The obstreperous children would not be still.
examples.text_zh: 这些吵闹的孩子就是不肯安静下来。

examples.text_en: He was obstreperous and would not follow us.
examples.text_zh: 他吵闹不休，不肯跟着我们。

examples.text_en: This book is obtainable in most big cities.
examples.text_zh: 这本书在大多数大城市都能买到。

examples.text_en: Good help was not obtainable that dark night.
examples.text_zh: 那个漆黑的夜晚找不到帮手。

examples.text_en: He did not want to obtrude his own ideas.
examples.text_zh: 他不想硬把自己的想法强加于人。

examples.text_en: Do not obtrude your problems on the group.
examples.text_zh: 别把你的问题强加给这个团队。

examples.text_en: His obtuse answer made the group stop.
examples.text_zh: 他那迟钝的回答让大家都停了下来。

examples.text_en: They called him obtuse for not seeing it.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他迟钝，连这都看不出来。

examples.text_en: The obverse of this old piece shows a king.
examples.text_zh: 这枚旧钱币的正面刻着一位国王。

examples.text_en: On the obverse we can see the date.
examples.text_zh: 在正面我们可以看到日期。

examples.text_en: A good plan can obviate many small problems.
examples.text_zh: 好的计划能避免许多小问题。

examples.text_en: This new way will obviate the old one.
examples.text_zh: 这种新方法将使旧的那套不再必要。

examples.text_en: The occidental man loved this old town.
examples.text_zh: 这位西方人喜爱这座古镇。

examples.text_en: She studied occidental art for many years.
examples.text_zh: 她研究西方艺术许多年。

examples.text_en: These dark things can occlude the whole light.
examples.text_zh: 这些黑暗的东西能遮住全部光线。

examples.text_en: The big wall will occlude our view of the game.
examples.text_zh: 那面大墙会挡住我们看比赛的视线。

examples.text_en: The old book is about occult powers and signs.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书讲的是神秘的力量和征兆。

examples.text_en: She had an occult way of knowing things.
examples.text_zh: 她有一种不可思议的预感能力。

examples.text_en: The occupant of this house is a young man.
examples.text_zh: 这栋房子的住户是个年轻人。

examples.text_en: Each occupant must keep the room in order.
examples.text_zh: 每个居住者都必须保持房间整洁。

examples.text_en: The occupants of the old house were very poor.
examples.text_zh: 这栋老房子里的住户非常贫穷。

examples.text_en: All the occupants left before the fire came.
examples.text_zh: 所有住户在火灾到来之前都撤离了。

examples.text_en: The octogenarian still walked to town each day.
examples.text_zh: 这位八旬老人每天仍然步行进城。

examples.text_en: An octogenarian told us about the old days.
examples.text_zh: 一位八旬老人给我们讲了过去的日子。
